usage_scope: system-wide CPU/RAM via psutil; GPU utilization and device memory via nvidia-smi; not process-specific
paging_or_swap_evidence: not recorded by benchmark; no historical pagefile or swap counters available in captured logs
monitoring_overhead: not separately measured; nvidia-smi subprocess polling and psutil sampling may add small overhead, but no causal correction is possible
vram_semantics: nvidia-smi memory.used and memory.total; device-reported used memory, not application allocator reserved memory
